query: Plan my running week and put the runs on my Google Calendar.
expected_behavior: Triggers the running-coach skill and routes to the week-planning capability (plan_week.py), not the single-run planner, the digest or the playlist
Reads references/week-planning.md and does not read the other capability references

Checks Strava for a goal (get_training_plan / get_athlete_profile) and, finding no writable weekly-goal field, asks the runner for a target and stores it via scripts/cache.py put goal_state rather than claiming it wrote the goal back to Strava
Runs scripts/cache.py status and refreshes performance / activities_history through the Strava MCP before proposing paces
Runs scripts/planning/plan_week.py propose and confirms the run count and mix with the runner before drafting
Runs plan_week.py draft and confirms days and times before generating events
Runs plan_week.py events --json and creates one Google_Calendar:create_event per run, only after confirmation, rather than reimplementing the payloads by hand
Never asks for or uses a Strava access token
